d3307.Raw_Article: 3307 Ta. tuṇi cloth for wear, hangings, pendants, decorations as of cloth, flag of a car, bark-cloth. Ma. tuṇi cloth. Ko. tuṇy priest's cloak (worn only at the milk-placing ceremony); Toda priest's garment. To. tüṇy dairyman's black garment of a single cloth. Koḍ. tuṇi cloth. Kor. (M.) tuṇḍu cloth. DED 2709.
